singleSourced.context: Sega had trumpeted "upgraded visuals," which include "improved textures, models, lighting, shadows, fog and environments, alongside modern rendering, anti-aliasing and upscaling options." The game also has optional 2.5D campaign movies inspired by Japanese Ukiyo-e art.
Total War: Shogun 2 — Complete Edition currently sits on an “overwhelmingly negative” user review rating on Steam, as customers who paid $10 to “upgrade” the game aired their grievances.

singleSourced.context:
Existing owners will still be able to access and play the game."

The team says it is "working closely with our development partner to identify the causes of these problems, deliver improvements, and ensure Shogun 2 Complete Edition meets the quality standards players expect from Total War." No further timeline has been given for now on when we might expect it to return to Steam.

The Complete Edition costs $39.99 / £34.99, and while you can get a 75% discount if you already own the original, bringing it down to $9.99 / £8.75, many user reviews express that it feels more like a free update than a full, paid remaster.
